Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one production concept-art atlas for a Chinese coastal-county survival game's map-selection briefing, containing EXACTLY FOUR independent landscape postcards in a flush 2 by 2 grid. Overall canvas 1536x1024 landscape; four equal 768x512 quadrants; hard straight seams at center, NO gutters, NO borders, NO captions, NO lettering, NO numerals, NO logos.
Style: restrained hand-painted environment art with clean opaque color blocks and decisive silhouettes, like a carefully edited graphic-novel background. Muted dark forest green, dusty olive, slate blue, warm concrete gray, a small amount of ochre/rust. Broad 3-tone shading, sparse line accents, mostly smooth matte flat surfaces. Consistent soft overcast daylight and coherent elevated three-quarter perspective across panels. Buildings should be grounded, orderly, readable at thumbnail size. Human-scale East Asian coastal county architecture. Atmosphere of abandonment and survival conveyed by a few deliberate signs, not indiscriminate debris.
Avoid: photorealism, satellite photography, glossy 3D render, busy tiny detail, procedural noise, paper grain, speckles, gritty overlays, grunge, sharpened microtextures, ornate fantasy, dramatic glowing beams, heavy fog, neon, zombies, people, weapons, UI elements. No text anywhere, even on storefronts or vessels. Do not draw gameplay paths or imply these are real implemented levels.
Composition: each of the four scenes is self-contained inside its quadrant, one clear focal landmark in its middle 70%, full-bleed environment with no cut-off key building. No object crosses the center seams. Create only the requested atlas.

Panel bottom-left: functioning county hospital precinct, sober light-gray modern clinic and ward block, covered ambulance entry, orderly courtyard and closed isolation wing; no medical cross or signage. Focal landmark: connected ward and canopy.
Panel bottom-right: abandoned former hospital, smaller older masonry ward with sparse vines, boarded entry and dark stairwell annex, dry courtyard, calm unease. Focal landmark: aging central ward.

refinement.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, a four-panel environment atlas. Image 2 is the STYLE REFERENCE ONLY, the approved county overview. Completely repaint Image 1 as clean simplified 2D illustrated scenery matching the smooth, broad, flat opaque color shapes of Image 2. Keep the exact four scene identities, their four equal quadrants, camera compositions, and landmark silhouettes from Image 1. Do not import the overview layout from Image 2.
CRITICAL: remove 85 percent of the small detail. This should look deliberately drawn by an illustrator, NOT a photograph or 3D render. Buildings are broad geometric planes in just three flat tones with clean edges. Windows are a few evenly placed dark rectangles. Trees and vines are single contiguous flat silhouettes with at most two green tones; absolutely no individual leaves or speckles. Roofs are solid color planes, absolutely no tiny roof tiles. Concrete is smooth, no stains, no grunge, no surface noise. Water is calm flat slate-blue bands. Sky uses two simple cloud shapes, not complex cloudy texture. Omit small street furniture and debris. Limit the whole atlas to a disciplined muted palette, with no gradients except an extremely restrained atmospheric sky. Readable thumbnail shape design and controlled negative space are more important than detail.
Strict 2 by 2 equal quadrant layout on 1536x1024 canvas, flush at center seams. No borders, captions, logos, text or numbers. This is concept art for region briefing cards, not gameplay imagery.
inputs: Each corresponding first-pass atlas as edit target
